# opencode-usage-dash

Local-first dashboard for OpenCode usage: the rolling five-hour, weekly and monthly plan windows, with every dollar split by model, plus your latest sessions and what each one cost. It runs on your own machine and reads your own OpenCode data, so nothing leaves it.

- Website: https://opencode-usage.4oli.com/
- Source: https://github.com/martinezharo/opencode-usage (MIT)
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-usage-dash
- Container: ghcr.io/martinezharo/opencode-usage
- Current version: 1.0.0
- Requirements: Node 23.4 or newer (uses the built-in `node:sqlite`)

## What it does

- Shows the three OpenCode Go plan windows — rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly — with real percentages and reset countdowns from the OpenCode Go usage API.
- Splits each window by model. Per-model costs, request counts and tokens come from the OpenCode console's usage API, so the dollars match the "Usage by model" table at opencode.ai/console.
- Hovering (or focusing, or tapping) a bar opens a panel with each model's cost, share, requests, input, output and cache-read tokens.
- Lists the latest sessions from the local database below the bars, each with its total cost and the models it used.
- Falls back to the local OpenCode database when the console or the plan API is unreachable, and to local time windows (rolling 5 hours, UTC week, UTC calendar month) when the plan API is down.
- Works without the Go plan: `--limits 20,50,100` sets your own caps, `--limits none` shows spend by model per window without percentages.
- Dark mode follows the system.

## Install

npx:

    npx opencode-usage-dash

Docker:

    docker run --rm \
      -p 127.0.0.1:4173:4173 \
      -v "$HOME/.local/share/opencode:/data:ro" \
      -e OPENCODE_DB=/data/opencode.db \
      -e OPENCODE_AUTH=/data/auth.json \
      ghcr.io/martinezharo/opencode-usage:latest

From source:

    git clone https://github.com/martinezharo/opencode-usage
    cd opencode-usage
    node bin/cli.mjs

The dashboard is served at http://127.0.0.1:4173 and reads `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` and `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` by default.

## Configuration

| Flag | Environment | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--port` | `PORT` | `4173` | Port to listen on. |
| `--host` | `HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Interface to bind. |
| `--open` / `--no-open` | `OPENCODE_USAGE_NO_OPEN=1` | auto (TTY) | Open the browser once ready. |
| `--db` | `OPENCODE_DB` | `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` | OpenCode database. |
| `--auth` | `OPENCODE_AUTH` | `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` | Where the API key lives. |
| `--limits` | `OPENCODE_USAGE_LIMITS` | `12,30,60` | Plan caps as `5h,weekly,monthly` dollars, or `none`. |

## Privacy

Everything runs locally. The only network requests are to the two OpenCode APIs, using your own key: `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` for plan percentages and `console.opencode.ai/api/usage/models` for per-model costs. There is no account, no telemetry, and the server binds to loopback by default.

## Notes

- Plan percentages use OpenCode's own accounting, which is a different scale from the console's model costs; the bars track the plan and the hover detail reports console activity, labelled in the page footer.
- The project is not affiliated with OpenCode or T3 Code.
